title: Single hieratic sign, Paris, Musée du Louvre, E 25416 (AKU HT 59495)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 59495

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 59495; AKU grapheme P0100 (AKU GR 498). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: P4 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 376. Source publication of this facsimile: Posener-Kriéger und Cenival 1968, pl. 34. Occurrence: line 4; find place Abusir; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 4.6 x 10.8 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 5. Dynastie, Djedkare". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
